summary: Greenpro Capital Corp. filed an 8-K reporting a subscription agreement with its CEO for a private placement of 107,310 shares at $2.3297/share, raising $250,000. The offering closed on April 28, 2026, increasing CEO beneficial ownership to ~11.16%. Shares were issued under Section 4(a)(2) and Regulation D/S without an underwriter. This is a routine capital raise from an insider for operating capital, not a transformative special situation. Proceeds are for general working capital.
